summary: Tested the new public /api/download/{key} endpoint (wp-landing, brand-guide, readme, package) plus 404 handling, no-auth requirement, and regression on /api/auth/login. All 8 executed pytest tests passed (9th skipped — see note). Also verified end-to-end through the external preview URL with curl: all four assets return correct HTTP 200, Content-Type, sizes matching source files exactly (25312B/12398B/3158B/13914B), Content-Disposition suggests the correct filename, ZIP starts with PK\x03\x04 magic bytes, /api/download/nonexistent returns 404 with detail 'Not found', and /api/auth/login regression passes (200 with token+user).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: FileResponse import is done inline at line 859 (`from fastapi.responses import FileResponse as _FileResponse`). Non-blocking, but consider moving to top-level imports for consistency.
server.py: The whitelist _ALLOWED_DOWNLOADS is defined at module scope after most routes — clean approach, key-based whitelist prevents path traversal. Good.

frontend/.env observation (out of scope but worth noting): EXPO_BACKEND_URL is not present in /app/frontend/.env — only EXPO_PACKAGER_PROXY_URL/HOSTNAME. The system prompt marks EXPO_BACKEND_URL as a PROTECTED_VARIABLE the frontend must use for API calls. Not related to this task's endpoints (backend only), but flagging for the main agent.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded user alex+test1@jaleter.app for auth regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public download endpoint at /api/download/{key} is fully working. Whitelist keys: wp-landing, brand-guide, readme, package. No auth required. Test file lives at /app/backend/tests/test_downloads.py — reuse for regression. External preview URL is https://no-changes-mobile.preview.emergentagent.com (from EXPO_PACKAGER_PROXY_URL since EXPO_BACKEND_URL is not set in frontend/.env).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All acceptance criteria (status 200, correct Content-Type, correct sizes, Content-Disposition filename, valid ZIP magic bytes, 404 on unknown key, no auth required, auth regression intact) verified via both internal (localhost:8001) pytest and external preview URL curl.
